study_type_evidence.quote: For each study, three Sprague Dawley rats (0.22-0.44 kg) were dosed as shown in Table 2.
Pseudovirion assays in Table 1 were performed as previously described.

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: Sprague Dawley, 0.22-0.44 kg; male rats per route in the Calvert study
in_vivo_species.quote: three Sprague Dawley rats (0.22-0.44 kg) were dosed as shown in Table 2
Three male cynomolgus monkeys (3.4-3.9 kg) were administered CPT31 ... intravenously as a single bolus injection

in_vitro_detail: HIV JRFL pseudovirion entry assay on HOS-CD4-CCR5 monolayers; IC50 only, no half-life.

agents.name: PIE12-trimer
agents.sequence: HPCDYPEWQWLCELGK (all D-amino acids except Gly; Ac- at N-terminus), trimerised on a PEG scaffold
agents.sequence_source: METHODS, Synthesis of PIE12-trimer and PIE12-trimer conjugates

agents.name: Palm-PIE12-trimer
agents.sequence: HPCDYPEWQWLCELGK (D-amino acids except Gly), trimer with palmitate on the fourth arm
agents.sequence_source: METHODS, Synthesis of PIE12-trimer and PIE12-trimer conjugates
agents.pk_quote: Palm-PIE12-trimer and Chol-PIE12-trimer showed a similarly increased IV half-life (3-fold) and significantly reduced clearance (~14-18-fold)

agents.name: C16-PIE12-trimer
agents.sequence: HPCDYPEWQWLCELGK (D-amino acids except Gly), trimer with 1-hexadecanethiol on the fourth arm
agents.sequence_source: METHODS, Synthesis of PIE12-trimer and PIE12-trimer conjugates
agents.pk_quote: The alkane conjugates (C16-PIE12-trimer and C18-PIE12-trimer) demonstrated modest increases in half-life upon IV or SC dosing (<2-fold)

agents.name: C18-PIE12-trimer
agents.sequence: HPCDYPEWQWLCELGK (D-amino acids except Gly), trimer with 1-octadecanethiol on the fourth arm
agents.sequence_source: METHODS, Synthesis of PIE12-trimer and PIE12-trimer conjugates
agents.pk_quote: C18-PIE12-trimer, also showed prolonged absorption from the subcutaneous space, but this effect did not increase the apparent terminal half-life

agents.name: Chol-PIE12-trimer
agents.sequence: HPCDYPEWQWLCELGK (D-amino acids except Gly), trimer with thiocholesterol on the fourth arm
agents.sequence_source: METHODS, Synthesis of PIE12-trimer and PIE12-trimer conjugates
agents.group_n_quote: Male rats per route were dosed with either Chol-PIE12-trimer (n=3), Chol-PEG5k-PIE12-trimer (n=3), or CPT31 (n=2)
agents.half_life: Table 2: 1.8 h IV, 2.7 h SC; repeat study Table 3: 1.6 h IV, 3.9 h SC
agents.half_life_elimination: 1.8 h IV and 2.7 h SC (Table 2); 1.6 h IV and 3.9 h SC (Table 3)
agents.cmax: 1112 nM C0 / 304 nM Cmax (Table 2); 4530 nM C0 / 395 nM Cmax (Table 3)
agents.pk_quote: we repeated the Chol-PIE12-trimer experiments to have a more accurate side-by-side comparison

agents.name: Chol-PEG5k-PIE12-trimer
agents.sequence: HPCDYPEWQWLCELGK (D-amino acids except Gly), trimer with 5 kDa PEG plus thiocholesterol on the fourth arm
agents.sequence_source: METHODS, Synthesis of PIE12-trimer and PIE12-trimer conjugates
agents.group_n_quote: Male rats per route were dosed with either Chol-PIE12-trimer (n=3), Chol-PEG5k-PIE12-trimer (n=3), or CPT31 (n=2)
agents.pk_quote: the added 5 kDa PEG resulted in a prolonged half-life (3.5-fold and 1.8-fold, respectively) when compared to Chol-PIE12-trimer

agents.name: CPT31
agents.sequence: HPCDYPEWQWLCELG-PEG4-K (PIE12-2 monomer, all D-amino acids except Gly), trimerised on a PEG27 scaffold with cholesteryl-PEG4 fourth arm
agents.group_n_quote: Male rats per route were dosed with either ... or CPT31 (n=2)
agents.dose: 1.0 mg/kg IV and SC (rat); 1 mg/kg IV and 3 mg/kg SC (monkey)
agents.half_life: rat: 3.3 h IV, 5.4 h SC; cynomolgus monkey: 7.4 h IV, 18.8 h SC
agents.half_life_elimination: 3.3 h IV and 5.4 h SC in rat
agents.half_life_matrix: rat plasma (monkey plasma for the NHP values)
agents.cmax: 2950 nM C0 (IV, rat); 261 nM Cmax (SC, rat)
agents.pk_quote: CPT31's IV and SC half-lives in rats increase 2-fold and 1.4-fold, respectively, compared to Chol-PIE12-trimer

agents.name: PEG40-PIE12-trimer
agents.sequence: HPCDYPEWQWLCELGK (D-amino acids except Gly), trimer with 40 kDa Y-branched PEG on the fourth arm
agents.sequence_source: METHODS, Synthesis of PIE12-trimer and PIE12-trimer conjugates
agents.pk_quote: Preliminary rat PK experiments with the 40 kDa PEG (PEG40) attached to PIE12-monomer showed a ~15-fold increase in circulating half-life

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: CPT31 Pharmacokinetics in Cynomolgous Monkeys. Characterization of single-dose PK curves for A) intravenous (1 mg/kg) and B) subcutaneous (3 mg/kg) dosing
concentration_time_figure.note: The only concentration-time figure is the cynomolgus monkey study; the rat PK is reported as tabulated parameters only (Tables 2 and 3), with no rat concentration-time curve.

bioanalytical_method: LC-MS/MS and UHPLC-Q-TOF MS on acetonitrile-precipitated plasma, quantified against an 8-point calibration curve with a Chol-PEG12-PIE12-trimer internal standard
bioanalytical_quote: Ions were formed by a dual electrospray source operated in positive-ion mode and detected on an Agilent quadrupole time-of-flight (Q-TOF) mass spectrometer (6540A).
notes: All rat half-lives are stated as median (range) of elimination half-life, not mean +/- SD; the table footnote defines T1/2=elimination half-life, so pk_phase is unambiguous. Chol-PIE12-trimer was run twice under different CROs (Navigen Table 2, Calvert Table 3) and PEPlife2 carries all four of its values as separate records, which is correct. The PEPlife2 rows for this PMID reproduce Tables 2 and 3 exactly; no correction needed. PEG40-PIE12-trimer's ~15-fold figure is for PIE12-monomer, not the trimer, and no absolute half-life is given, so it is left unreported.
